headline: Actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon assaulted in Venice by expatriates
summary: The actress claimed she was targeted by members of the Awami League and Chhatra League due to her support for the July movement.
details: Actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon was physically assaulted and harassed in Venice, Italy, on Monday night, September 7.
Badhon shared the incident via a Facebook Live session, stating that a group of expatriates threw water and rotten eggs at her while she was in a park with her brother and his young child.
She alleged that the individuals identified themselves as members of the Venice Awami League and Chhatra League, targeting her for her support of the July movement.
The actress claimed the attackers slapped her on the ear and knocked her phone out of her hand, while forcing her to chant slogans like 'Joy Bangla, Joy Bangabandhu' for their videos.
A video of the incident shows the attackers attempting to confront her while her brother tried to move her to a safety.
Badhon appeared visibly distressed in her Facebook Live, with her face appearing red and swollen from the attack.
She had traveled to Italy to attend the Venice Film Festival.
The actress has filed a formal complaint with the local Italian police regarding the assault.
caption:
Actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon was assaulted in Venice, Italy, after being targeted for her political views. She claims attackers forced her to chant slogans while throwing rotten eggs at her.

Actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon was physically assaulted and harassed in Venice, Italy, on Monday night, September 7.

Badhon shared the incident via a Facebook Live session, stating that a group of expatriates threw water and rotten eggs at her while she was in a park with her brother and his young child.

She alleged that the individuals identified themselves as members of the Venice Awami League and Chhatra League, targeting her for her support of the July movement.

The actress claimed the attackers slapped her on the ear and knocked her phone out of her hand, while forcing her to chant slogans like 'Joy Bangla, Joy Bangabandhu' for their videos.

A video of the incident shows the attackers attempting to confront her while her brother tried to move her to a safety.

Badhon appeared visibly distressed in her Facebook Live, with her face appearing red and swollen from the attack.

She had traveled to Italy to attend the Venice Film Festival.

The actress has filed a formal complaint with the local Italian police regarding the assault.
